title: Solet setup flow contract
description: Declarative contract for a repository-delivered, resumable setup wizard. The contract separates requirements from decisions, lets each option activate a different implementation, keeps the user in the authorization path, and requires positive verification before completion.

source_revision.description: Optional immutable repository revision used to produce this contract.

operation_ref.description: Trusted resolver key. Arbitrary shell command text is intentionally not part of this contract.
